summary.zh: 新增只读命令 agenthelm inventory：列出各客户端能看到的 Skill 与 MCP（含 ~/.agents/skills、项目级与 Claude 本地级存储）、重复、description 字节数与可识别来源，输出带 schema_version 的稳定 JSON。
summary.en: Add the read-only command agenthelm inventory: list the Skills and MCP servers each client can see (including ~/.agents/skills, project-level and Claude local-level stores), duplicates, description bytes and recognizable origin, as stable JSON carrying schema_version.
